title: PO↔ALL-RELEASE-001: Release Gate Status + OTA Release Calendar
description: Product Owner/TPM publishes the OTA release-train schedule and tracks the ordered Release Gate Sequence (CLAUDE.md §6.7); each gating role reports its sign-off. The PO release decision is gate 4 and cannot precede the Architect, Security, and QA gates. Grounded in FIRMWARE_ENGINEER_SKILL §6.12 (PO/TPM) and the Release Gate Sequence. Models a release record, not a single deliverable.

seasonal_constraint_note.description: AgriSpectra deploys in seasonal windows; note any blackout.

release_gate_sequence.description: Ordered gates per CLAUDE.md §6.7; must not be reversed or skipped. Each downstream gate requires all prior gates PASS.

gate1_architect_signoff.description: NFR matrix green, no TBD, OTA path integrity (HG-04).

gate3_qa_go_no_go.description: QA go/no-go; NO_GO on any open Critical FMEA chain (RPN ≥ 200).

gate4_po_release_decision.description: PO/TPM release decision (this contract's owning gate).

gate5_ota_readiness.description: OCM per model; A/B rollback verified.

open_critical_fmea_chains.description: Count of open Critical FMEA chains (RPN ≥ 200) with no mitigation; must be 0 for QA GO (Prime Directive §10.1).

feature_acceptance.description: Feature requirements + testable acceptance criteria for capabilities in this release.

release_adr_ref.description: Release ADR with the BIA appended.

x-macp.tier_rationale: Production release gating spans HG-01 (SEC veto), HG-04 (Architect production gate), and the QA go/no-go — all permanent HITL gates. No agent may produce a release-APPROVED record that bypasses them.
x-macp.cadence: TRIGGER (release-gate readiness review); SLA_FROM_EVENT (milestone-slip notification within 1 business day of a confirmed slip)
confirm_conditions: gates evaluated strictly in order 1→6; each gate PENDING until all prior gates pass
gate4_po_release_decision = APPROVED only when gate1 PASS, gate2 PASS, gate3 GO
ota_calendar window is consistent (start < end) and respects seasonal constraints
release_adr_ref present with BIA appended for gate6 PASS
reject_conditions: gate4 APPROVED while gate2 = VETO or gate3 = NO_GO (bypasses HG-01/QA gate — ESC-TIER1)
gate3 = GO with open_critical_fmea_chains > 0 (violates Prime Directive §10.1)
gates recorded out of order or a gate skipped
any release rationale arguing to ship around open Critical chains
counter_conditions: a gate is PENDING past its SLA — request status (ESC-SLA), do not infer PASS
feature acceptance_criteria_met = false on a committed feature — request scope/priority reconciliation
